We're now bringing Drive across Wolt and Deliveroo countries together into <strong>one EMEA business</strong>, with one team and a clear ambition: grow fast and build a business that stands on its own feet.</p> <p>A growing share of that scaling comes from outside restaurants: grocers, retailers, pharmacies and other eComm players who want on-demand and same-day delivery for their own customers.
